nodes.label: Estratégia de implementação do Rootine
nodes.summary: Source of truth for the Rootine roadmap: 11 implementation prompts covering navigation/security, database + RLS, shared domain validators, rich onboarding, deterministic Aventura (flashcards/quizzes), deterministic user brain, hyper-personalized Trilha missions via mission_patterns + AI Mission Composer, safe mission editing, XP/impact/achievements/Habitat, Perfil/Cientista/Biosfera, and hardening/observability. Core principle: the main flow must work without paid AI; AI improves text but is never the source of truth for user facts, impact, XP, or category.
